- Pilot: 3 people, ran tests in Dec (about ~4k tokens used)

I've attached a short summary of what we ran and the remaining test plan. Appreciate any flexibility here — we liked Redwood's perf during initial tests and want to move quickly.

Thanks,

Looping in with recommended options for ClearPath. I reviewed Evan's summary and usage — they used only ~4k tokens and clearly paused. Proposed options:

1) 30-day time extension on the existing trial (no additional credit units) — low-friction, quick to apply.
2) Reactivate 30k tokens credit for the workspace (recommended if they need headroom for larger A/B tests).
3) A smaller reactive grant (5k tokens) + guidance call + prioritized onboarding support.

I'd suggest option 2 if they're likely to run scale tests; option 3 if we're limited on promotional budget. There's a HubSpot note under deal DP-2026-4127 with their procurement cadence — I linked it below.

If Aditya can approve the promotional budget, I can send the formal confirmation to Evan and attach the reactivated-credit stub for their records.
